summary: Strong frustration—repeating same bug report after false fix claim
detailed_context: Nick just sent this identical message a second time. The AI previously responded claiming the issue was 'Fixed and live as v1.11.1,' but Nick's repetition signals the fix didn't actually work. Two core issues remain: (1) no 'add budget' button on category page, and (2) edit modal doesn't prefill budget data. Repeating the same complaint after a confident 'fixed' response is a major miss—the AI misunderstood the problem or provided false information. Nick is clearly frustrated at having to restate the issue.
